messages:
noah: quick heads-up — opened PR that changes how prod overlay wires secrets. switching from SSM param paths to Secrets Manager secrets and updating kustomize overlays to reference the new secret keys. need a sanity check before we gate the release: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/923 :eyes:
amira: thanks — which services are impacted? staging already on the new mapping?
noah: only model-router and billing-svc in prod; staging already migrated last week (no issues). ingress-proxy unaffected.
kevin: curious about Terraform plan drift — are we renaming secrets or creating new ones? if new, will the old SSM params remain?
noah: creating new Secrets Manager secrets (prod-only), leaving SSM params intact for 48h and then delete after verification. TF snippet from the PR:
```hcl
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "model_router_api" {
  name = "rwd/prod/model-router/api-keys"
  description = "Prod API keys for model-router (migrated from ssm)"
}
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "model_router_api_ver" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.model_router_api.id
  secret_string = jsonencode({ key = var.model_router_api_key })
}
```
noah: and kustomize overlay (prod) patch to mount the secret as environment var:
```yaml
patchesStrategicMerge:
- |
  apiVersion: apps/v1
  kind: Deployment
  metadata:
    name: model-router
  spec:
    template:
      spec:
        containers:
        - name: model-router
          env:
          - name: MODEL_API_KEY
            valueFrom:
              secretKeyRef:
                name: rwd-prod-model-router-api-keys
                key: key
```
sre-liz: couple checks from SRE side:
- confirm KMS key policy for Secrets Manager allows cross-account read by staging if needed
- ensure ArgoCD overlay refresh will pick up the new secret name (we rely on annotated app sync)
jen: small note on the release gating workflow — the gate expects a `overlay-verification=true` annotation on the kustomize patch for prod to auto-promote. PR doesn't have it yet, will block automatic promote unless we add it.
noah: good catch, adding the annotation. also updated the release runbook with manual rollback steps and TF state notes.
kevin: ran `terraform plan` locally. small nit: the plan shows replacement for `aws_iam_role.policy` for billing-svc because of the new policy attachment. I left a comment on the PR with the plan output snippet.
deploy-bot: CI plan finished — 1 change to add, 2 replacements, 0 deletes. (link: https://ci.internal/redwood/923/plan)
amira: can someone double-check the secret name mapping in ArgoCD values.yaml? I don't want a prod deploy pointing at the staging secret name by mistake.
noah: confirmed — Argo values get templated from `/overlays/prod/values.yaml` which now uses `rwd/prod/*` prefix. pushing fix to values.yaml in same PR.
kevin: i'll do a quick smoke on staging again (deploy with the new env mapping) and report back in ~15m.
sre-liz: after smoke please run `kubectl get secret -n prod | grep rwd-prod` and paste output here so ops can verify the Kubernetes secret exists before we flip traffic.
noah: noted. adding test step to the gating checklist: `kubectl -n prod get secret rwd-prod-model-router-api-keys -o jsonpath='{.data.key}' | base64 --decode`
jen: once smoke passes, i'll mark the release gate ready and the pipeline will run the canary. if anything weird, hit me in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
kevin: staging smoke looks clean, model-router picks up the new env var and connects. no auth errors observed.
noah: thanks all — i'll merge once jen marks gate ready and then monitor logs for 30m post-promote. adding everyone to the runbook section for post-deploy checks. :shipit:
